defs.def: a large board with a smooth black or dark green surface that teachers write on with a piece of chalk 黑板

ex.s: All the assignments will be submitted by the assigned date through Blackboard, our online learning and course management system.
ex.t: 所有作业必须在指定日期前通过Blackboard提交，这是我们的在线学习和课程管理系统。

ex.s: The schools have tablets and touchscreens instead of books and blackboards in the classrooms.
ex.t: 这些学校的教室里用平板电脑和触摸屏取代了书本和黑板。
